title: Your Credit Limit Is Not Your Money
description:
Exposing the myth behind credit card limits. A high limit is a measure of bank risk, not personal affordability. Learn how minimum payments on high interest debt trap cash flow for decades.

The Money Reset Kit (paid), and the free Money Reset checklist: https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/links/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=money-reset-kit&utm_content=2026-11-01-s0-myth-myth-your-credit-limit-is-what-y&o=money-reset-kit

caption:
